layout_note: NT back-matter glossary of hard/Latinate words, set in TWO columns of small roman with italic headwords. The section OPENS at the foot of scan 798, directly BELOW the end of 'A Table of Controversies' (whose last entries, letters W/Z ending 'The madde zeale of heretikes.342 m.', occupy the top two columns of 798 under running header 'OF CONTROVERSIES.'). A horizontal rule separates the table from a full-width 4-line centred display heading; the two-column glossary then begins. It continues on scan 799 (running header centred 'HARD VVORDES EXPLICATED.') and ENDS with the last entry 'Victims, Sacrifices. p.303.' A rule follows, then a SEPARATE errata section 'The faultes correcte thus.' and the colophon 'LAVS DEO.' (both on 799, NOT part of this section, excluded). Reading order across the spread: 798 left col (A,C) -> 798 right col (C cont., D) -> 799 left col (D cont., E,G,H,I,N,P) -> 799 right col (P cont., R,S,T,V). Alphabetical letter headings A C D E G H I N P R S T V are centred between the entries (no B,F,K,L,M,O,Q,U/X/Y/Z headings printed). Page references for most entries are right-justified to the column edge on the entry's last line; a minority are inline. These back-matter leaves are UNPAGINATED (no folio numbers); placement is by quire signature 'Eeeee ij' (foot of 798) and the catchword 'Domi-' (foot-right of 798, anticipating 'Dominical day' atop 799). Language: English glossary with Latin/Greek-derived headwords. Glyph regime: small two-sort vv fount (see glyph_regime_resolved).

intervals.text: THE EXPLICATION OF CERTAINE VVORDES IN THIS TRANSLATION, NOT FAMILIAR to the vulgar reader, vvhich might not conueniently be vttered otherwiſe.

Catechizeth, and, Catechized. p.510. He catechizeth that teacheth the principles of the Chriſtian faith : and they that heare and learne, are catechized, and are therfore called often in the Annotations, Catechumens.
Character, a marke or ſtampe. pag.723.
Commeſſations, Immoderate bankets, and belly cheere, vvith vvanton riotouſnes. p.509.

Cooperate, ſignifieth vvorking vvith others, p.401. likevviſe Cooperation, Cooperatours.

Holocauſte, a kinde of ſacrifice vvhere al vvas burnt in the honour of God. p.625.
Inuocated, called vpon, praied vnto. p.316. Hereof vve ſay, Inuocation of Saincts, and to inuocate.

Paraſceue, the Ievves Sabboth-eue, Good friday. p.130.v.43. See the Preface..
Paſche, Eaſter, and, the Paſchal lambe. p.201.
Pentecoſt, vvhitſuntide, &, the ſpace of fiftie daies.

Reſolution, the ſeparation of the body and the ſoule, the departing out of this life. p.592.

glyph_regime_resolved: NT-1582 back-matter GLOSSARY fount ('HARD VVORDES EXPLICATED', scans 798-799) = the small TWO-SORT vv apparatus fount (same family as the adjacent 'Table of Controversies'). Lowercase w is set as GAPPED vv in the overwhelming majority (~45 instances read at zoom with clear inter-stroke gaps: Dravven, avvay, knovvledge, acknovvledging, alvvaies, vvorld, vvord(x3), vvith, vvanton, vvorking, likevviſe, vvhere, vvas, vve, nevv, vvrong, vvhereof, vvhitſuntide, foreknovvledge, vvere, othervviſe[l.93], Ievves[x2], vvhich[title l.2 & l.93], north-eaſtvvinde, vvithout...). Per-glyph inspection found exactly TWO connected single-sort w exceptions, kept as 'w': 'otherwiſe' (title l.3, contrasting gapped 'vvhich' in the SAME title) and line-end 'renew' (l.92) — textbook mixed-regime per Sir's §w-regime (same compositor grabs whichever sort is in the case). DISPLAY titling caps 'VVORDES' (title l.0) = gapped VV (the titling fount has no W sort) — kept. long-ſ read GLYPH-DRIVEN: round final s preserved (bankets, others, labours, holies, ſacrifices, ſinnes, daies, Angels, Sacrifices, Thrones); long-ſ medial/initial (ſignifieth, Chriſt, Goſpel, myſterie, ceaſing...); ſt/ſh/ſc ligatures transcribed as component letters (ſt in Abſtracted/Contriſtate/Holocauſte/Pentecoſt/reſting/inmoſt/holieſt/ſtone; ſh in languiſheth; ſc in Paraſceue/Reſuſcitate/Preſcience). ct always ligature but transcribed c+t (Character, Sancta Sanctorum, Victims). u/v period-swap and i/j preserved as printed (vpon, vnto, vs, giuen, reuiue, heauie, vttered, Gouernour, iniurie, iuſt, Ievves, Iuſtice, Victims). Nasal macron/tilde preserved (attēding l.16, cōcerneth l.53, cō- l.68, trãſ- l.82). Latin/Greek headwords transcribed as set (Corbana, Depoſitum, Didrachme, Euro-aquilo, Paraſceue, Sancta Sanctorum, Sabbatiſme, Superedified).
